name: Pokemon Stadium 1-2 Overworld Models (Gen 1-2)
description: Pokemon Stadium 3D overworld models supporting National Dex 1-151 for Gen 1 (Stadium 1 ROM) and 1-251 for Gen 2 (Stadium 2 ROM) with Followers EX and Dramatic Sky Ride compatibility.

required_imports.name: Pokemon Stadium (USA) ROM for Gen 1
required_imports.description: Required source ROM for Stadium 1 model extraction (Gen 1 games only). .z64, .v64 and .n64 dumps are all accepted; the mod normalises the byte order itself.

required_imports.name: Pokemon Stadium 2 (USA) ROM for Gen 2
required_imports.description: Required source ROM for Stadium 2 model extraction (Gen 2 games only). .z64, .v64 and .n64 dumps are all accepted; the mod normalises the byte order itself.
